question: Identify the product descriptions purchased by KAM customers who consumed less than 30,000 units in 2012 and made transactions at Czech gas stations.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_009"
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
JOIN products AS p ON p."XCL_008" = t."XCL_016"
JOIN gasstations AS g ON g."XCL_004" = t."XCL_015"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'KAM'
  AND t."XCL_017" < 30000
  AND strftime('%Y', t."XCL_011") = '2012'
  AND g."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
